in_sanskrit.name: हृदिथा
in_sanskrit.meaning: she who has a heart, mind, and intellect
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word 'hrudya' means heart, 'manas' means mind, and 'buddhi' means intellect. So, 'Hruditha' means 'she who has a heart, mind, and intellect'.

in_hindi.name: हृदिथा
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, 'Hruditha' is translated as 'हृदय दाना', which means 'giver of heart' or 'compassionate one'.

in_tamil.name: ஹ்ருடிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, 'Hruditha' is translated as 'ஹ்ருத்திரும் ஆவால்', which means 'she who has a compassionate heart'.

in_telugu.name: హ్రుదిథా
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, 'Hruditha' is translated as 'హృద్యపోయేదు', which means 'she who has a compassionate heart'.

in_marathi.name: Hruditha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे She who moves the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hruditha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hruditha is derived from the Sanskrit roots ‘hru’ meaning heart and ‘ditha’ meaning moving or causing to move. It signifies a woman who has the power to stir the heart and emotions of those around her.

It signifies a woman who has the power to stir the heart and emotions of those around her.
